involved_tools.name: read_file
involved_tools.description:
Read a local file or, when isUrl is true, fetch content from a URL. Supports line-based pagination for text, structured extraction for common document formats, and content retrieval for images.

Usage rules:
- Provide path. Local files must be within allowed directories; absolute paths are most reliable.
- For text, offset is a zero-based line position and length limits returned lines. Negative offset reads from the end; length is ignored for negative offsets. URL content is read in full regardless of pagination.
- For Excel files, optionally select sheet by name or zero-based index as a string and use range in FROM:TO form; offset and length can paginate rows as a fallback. For PDFs, pagination is by page.
- DOCX reads return a text-bearing outline by default. A nonzero offset with length requests paginated raw XML; offset=0 returns the outline.
- Set isUrl=true to read a URL rather than a local path.

involved_tools.name: write_file
involved_tools.description:
Write content to a file, replacing it by default or appending when requested. Supports text and spreadsheet data; use the dedicated PDF tool to create or modify PDFs.

Usage rules:
- Provide path and content. Files must be within allowed directories; absolute paths are most reliable.
- The default mode is rewrite, which replaces the file contents. Set mode=append to add content to the end.
- Excel content may be a JSON 2D array or an object mapping sheet names to 2D arrays.
- For long content, multiple calls can use rewrite followed by append; inspect the file if a prior write was partial.
